propositions: 429 HTTP responses with Retry-After headers on idempotent reads must be retried with jitter up to 20% and clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S
The rate_limit_retry opt-in flag must default to False and propagate through both _call_logged (PATH A: _paged_search route) and direct _with_connection_retry calls (PATH B: per-issue comment fetch)
All mutation operations (create_issue, add_comment, update_issue, etc.) must fail immediately on first 429 without retry to avoid duplicate writes
Rate limit exhaustion must raise BackendHTTPError with code 429, never exposing raw JIRAError across the adapter boundary
Four specific read call sites (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map paged search, get_comment_map per-issue fetch, get_parent_map) must explicitly pass rate_limit_retry=True
Retry-After header must be read from exc.response.headers not exc.headers, and gracefully degrade to no retry when header is absent
